nodes.label: Technology Tree Animation Sequence (Frames 484-560)
nodes.description: Animation frames 484-560 from an ezgif sequence depicting a stylized technology tree. The animation shows a glowing tree with digital/circuit-board roots and a canopy populated with technology logos and platform names including React, Next.js, Django, Node.js, MongoDB, GSAP, SharePoint, GPT, Power Apps, Power Automate, Bi, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure AD, and an AI label at the top. The sequence is part of a longer animation transitioning from a plain nature tree with bioluminescent blue roots to a fully branded technology ecosystem tree. Produced with Veo (Google video generation).
nodes.note: Source frames 484-560 not found in repository (frames only go up to 240); node is inferred from adjacent frames 120 and 230 which show the same animation sequence context.
